description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, restricting a stationary set to nonzero limits leaves a stationary set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.stationary_restrict_limits.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) {S : Set α} (hS : IsStationary S) :
  IsStationary (S ∩ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.limitOrdinals α)
